required_changes.defect: These records mint `hosafot` as a new second path component under `rosh_hashanah`. SIDDUR_URN_SCHEME.md:72-82,107-113 makes `hosafot` a closed-list occasion: units said on every occasion in addition to what the occasion calls for. It is not a service, and the occasion and service lists are closed precisely so that two siddurim produce the same `siddur:` URN. `rosh_hashanah/hosafot/...` puts an occasion token in the service/unit slot, so it cannot align with another book's `siddur:hosafot/...` additions. The daily Unity hymns and Anim Zemirot are exactly the additions that occasion describes. Context records for `rosh_hashanah/hosafot` are new in this candidate, so this is not inherited precedent.
required_changes.remedy: Re-root the structural contexts under the closed-list occasion, e.g. `siddur:hosafot/hymns_appendix` and `siddur:hosafot/shir_hakavod/opening_psalm` (with its quotation children). Alternatively, if the book is held to confine them to Rosh Hashanah, drop the token (`siddur:rosh_hashanah/hymns_appendix`). Then regenerate the idnos, div corresps, quotation milestones, expanded transclusion and documentary index transclusion. Pre-1.0, replace the URNs outright with no alias.
